title: Compose follow-up Outcome recording in the PWA

gates.name: follow_up_outcome_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/follow-up-outcome.spec.ts

verify: Independent Outcome verification covers exact eligible completed-Task input/evidence, success/retry/transition/version/permission/archive failures, authoritative reread, and no frontend-derived Dataset authority.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-028 RED: no browser follow-up Outcome consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized Outcome/evidence input commits for an eligible completed Task while retry/transition/version/permission/archive failures remain truthful and non-mutating; decisive comparison: request, response/DOM, authoritative Task/Outcome/Dataset reread; artifact: Outcome evidence under .tasks/TASK-106-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose follow-up Outcome recording independently of Task reads, approval, and completion.
success_outcome: An authorized Boss/Engineer can record the exact Outcome/evidence for an eligible completed Task while rejected/retried requests leave Task, Outcome, Dataset, and audit authority consistent.
anti_goals: Do not implement reads, Safety approval, Task completion, arbitrary Outcome/Task creation, or Dataset mutation controls.
Do not derive attribution, evidence authority, follow-up eligibility, or trainability in the PWA.

stop_conditions: Outcome recording requires a command outside Task And Approval HTTP.
The PWA would need to infer evidence, transition, attribution, or Dataset state.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Task & Follow-Up owns Outcome transition and evidence composition.
Send only registered Outcome fields and render backend response/refs.
invariants: Outcome presentation cannot grant Dataset trainability or create follow-up authority.
Denied/retried requests preserve one authoritative Task/Outcome/evidence state.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-028: exact Outcome/evidence success plus retry/transition/version/permission/archive failures and authoritative reread.
T3 harm proof uses isolated Tasks/Outcomes and confirms safe rerun/denial leaves no duplicate or unauthorized Dataset/audit effect.
